places.name: CSU Spur
places.why: Completely free and open to the public — mock vet clinic, play kitchen, water table, and hands-on spots across three buildings; feels like a children's museum without the price. 2nd Saturdays add extra activities (Days.in.denver monthly favorite).
places.hours: Mon–Fri 9am–5pm; 2nd Saturdays 10am–2pm; closed other Sat & Sun
places.toddler_notes: Great for ~20 months: indoor play kitchen, water table, mock vet. Free year-round (except Stock Show grounds fee).
places.drive_note: ~19 min drive from W 64th Ave & Ward Rd, Arvada, CO 80004 (~9.2 mi straight-line)

places.name: Apex Center (Indoor Playground)
places.why: Days.in.denver: 'basically an entire day under one roof' — indoor water park, ice rinks, climbing wall, and a FREE indoor playground for little kids (Colorado-themed with tots area ~1–3).
places.hours: Open daily; check Apex schedule for playground/pool hours
places.cost: Daily admission typically ~$10.50 kids / $12.50 adults (playground included; verify)
places.toddler_notes: Tots section — ideal for ~20 months. Right in Arvada.
places.drive_note: ~4 min drive from W 64th Ave & Ward Rd, Arvada, CO 80004 (~1.0 mi straight-line)

places.name: Belleview Park (Farm & Train)
places.why: Highlighted by Colorado Kids Explore and Days.in.denver: free park with playgrounds and creek; seasonal petting farm and miniature train (~$3 ages 2+, under 2 free).
source_accounts: Facebook: Colorado Kids Explore - Adventure Guide
places.hours: Park: dawn–dusk. Farm & Train: typically Memorial Day–Labor Day (~9am–3:30pm; check city)
places.toddler_notes: Under-2 free for farm/train. Creek play + playground year-round.
places.drive_note: ~34 min drive from W 64th Ave & Ward Rd, Arvada, CO 80004 (~14.7 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)
